meta.description: Automate Ambient Weather tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动处理天气数据并触发相应操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要从天气站获取数据并集成到工作流中。
copy.tagline_en: Automate weather data processing and trigger actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to fetch weather station data and integrate it into your workflows.

howto.what: Claude 能够通过 Rube MCP 连接 Ambient Weather 服务，自动发现可用工具，并根据指令执行天气数据查询、监控等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要获取 Ambient Weather 设备数据或执行自动化操作（如查询温度、设置规则等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我查询最近的 Ambient Weather 温度数据。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具获取最新数据。

say.text: 自动监控 Ambient Weather 设备状态，有异常时提醒我。
say.note: Claude 会定期检查并报告状态。

howto.what_en: Claude can connect to Ambient Weather via Rube MCP, discover tools automatically, and perform tasks like querying weather data or monitoring devices as instructed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to get data from Ambient Weather devices or automate operations (e.g., query temperature, set rules).

say_en.text: Get the latest Ambient Weather temperature data.
say_en.note: Claude will use the tool to fetch current data.

say_en.text: Monitor Ambient Weather device status and alert me on anomalies.
say_en.note: Claude will periodically check and report status.
